facts.fact: The State Department for Livestock Development says its Kenya Livestock Insurance Program uses satellite-derived NDVI forage availability to decide payouts in arid and semi-arid counties, with cover implemented by the State Department and county governments.
The State Department for Livestock Development says KLIP has covered 100,000 people in six years, with payouts of KSh 1.3 billion.

KEN.note: Premiums are the government's; the private money named is a regional project aim with no amount into a digital business.
